elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Want to know which app used your mic last night?

[confident] Here's the fix. Open the privacy dashboard.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Security and privacy. Tap Privacy dashboard. Tap Microphone to see every app and when. Set the odd one to Don't allow.

[delighted] Now you know exactly which apps were listening.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
